classification.difficultyReason: Directly applies the specified trapezoidal method: translate five function values into four subintervals, generate equally spaced inputs, weight endpoints and interior values, and round. Different integrands require no change of strategy.

content.prompt: Use the trapezoidal rule with five function values to approximate each definite integral, writing your answer correct to three significant figures where necessary.

answer.worked:
Five function values give four subintervals.
$$\begin{aligned}h&=\frac{6-2}{4}=1\\x&=2,3,4,5,6\\T&=\frac12\left[\frac12+\frac16+2\left(\frac13+\frac14+\frac15\right)\right]\\&=\frac{67}{60}\\&\approx1.12\quad\text{(3 s.f.)}\end{aligned}$$

Five function values give four subintervals.
$$\begin{aligned}h&=\frac{2-0}{4}=\frac12\\x&=0,\frac12,1,\frac32,2\\T&=\frac14\left[\frac12+\frac{1}{2+\sqrt2}+2\left(\frac{1}{2+\sqrt{1/2}}+\frac13+\frac{1}{2+\sqrt{3/2}}\right)\right]\\&\approx0.70464\\&\approx0.705\quad\text{(3 s.f.)}\end{aligned}$$

Five function values give four subintervals.
$$\begin{aligned}h&=\frac{8-4}{4}=1\\x&=4,5,6,7,8\\T&=\frac12\left[\sqrt{13}+\sqrt{61}+2\left(\sqrt{22}+\sqrt{33}+\sqrt{46}\right)\right]\\&\approx22.9252\\&\approx22.9\quad\text{(3 s.f.)}\end{aligned}$$

Five function values give four subintervals.
$$\begin{aligned}h&=\frac{2-1}{4}=\frac14\\x&=1,1.25,1.5,1.75,2\\T&=\frac18\bigl[\log_{10}1+\log_{10}2+2(\log_{10}1.25+\log_{10}1.5+\log_{10}1.75)\bigr]\\&\approx0.166638\\&\approx0.167\quad\text{(3 s.f.)}\end{aligned}$$
